do we want to allow xx as a placeholder wildcard for unknown future devices
or do we as a community want to adopt the rule from the device tree world where we pick one and add each additional as we encounter it?

are the parameters really such they can be transparently substituted with no parameter changes? or would a different device require a different configuration or board footprint?

In my understanding the XX in the enum values serves as a placeholder for different versions/iterations of the same chip, with different physical properties (e.g. pin count, pagaging), but in regards of updating, these chips follow the exact same process/protocol. Hence I do not expect a change in properties.

As source I was linked to this:
https://github.com/facebook/openbmc/blob/f69624d471ea08c3b6d37b163ae11aeab7f8ff42/common/recipes-lib/vr/files/xdpe152xx.h

It shall not serve as a placeholder for any future device, but as a class of devices which share the same update-process/protocol, even if the physical properties differ.

This should be XDPE1X2XX, right?

There's no common i2c firmware update protocol that I'm aware of here, so this would just be listing the model of the VR, right?  We already have objects that represent the VRs?

This schema definition is for listing the properties needed for firmware update for i2c vr for which the first supported usecase is XDPE1X2XX. This is written with intent that in future when the reactor is updated to add support for more i2c vr type, the schema enum needs to be updated to add that to the type list. 

Now, having said that, one can also say this I2CVRFirmware schema might not apply to other I2C VRs in future as they might need more properties as you mentioned there is no common i2c firmware update protocol.

So, i see 2 options here -
1. Keep this as such for now and revisit it in future when more i2c vrs gets added.
2. Change both schema node name and type to "XDPE1X2XXFirmware" now itself and in future we will see how to harmonize if anything is possible.

Please tell which option seems reasonable to you?

@christopher.meis@9elements.com Lets follow Option#2 for now and change both schema name and Type to "XDPE1X2XXFirmware" as thats what Ed's comment seems to be pointing to. We can discuss in future on how to represent more i2c VR types when they get added.
